title: Efficient Online RFT with Plug-and-Play LLM Judges: Unlocking State-of-the-Art Performance
reasoning: The paper utilizes the RewardBench dataset for evaluation, which specifically includes 'Safety' (toxicity and bias) and 'Ethics' as core evaluation axes. Additionally, it evaluates model rationales based on human values such as harmlessness and helpfulness through the newly introduced HH-Rationales dataset.
